questions.question: What is the sum of digits of the least number which when divided by 21, 28, 30 and 35 leaves the same remainder 10 in each case but is divisible by 17?
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

Least number when divided by 21, 28, 30, and 35 leaves 10 as a remainder in each case 

**Concept**

**When a number divides by certain numbers and leaves same remainder in each case then their LCM also divisibly by that number**

**CALCULATION:-**

On Taking L.C.M of 21, 28, 30, and 35 = 420

Least number 420k + 10 is divisible by 17 = 420 × 2 + 10 = 850

Least number which when divided by 21, 28, 30 , and 35 leaves 10

as a remainder in each case but divisible by 17 = 850

**∴Sum of digits of this least number = 8 + 5 + 0 = 13**

questions.question: After allowing a discount of 12(1)/(2)% on the marked price of an article. it was sold for ₹700. Had the discount NOT been given, the profit would have been 60%.The cost price of the article is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Discount = 12.5% = 1/8 ⇒ SP = (1 − 1/8) × MP = 7/8 of MP.

Given SP = ₹700 ⇒ 7/8 × MP = 700 ⇒ MP = ₹800.

If no discount is given, SP = MP = ₹800.

Profit = 60% = 3/5 ⇒ SP = (1 + 3/5) × CP = 8/5 of CP.

Since SP = ₹800 ⇒ 8/5 × CP = 800 ⇒ CP = ₹500.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) = ₹700

Discount = 12.5%

Profit without discount = 60%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e39ea6c6551667216f693d339e9c391030746fe6ed01f6c3ecc1325975e6cacd.png] 

**Formula Used:**

SP = MP × (100 − Discount%) ÷ 100

SP = CP × (100 + Profit%) ÷ 100

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let Marked Price be MP.

⇒ SP = MP × (100 − 12.5) ÷ 100

⇒ 700 = MP × 87.5 ÷ 100

⇒ 700 = MP × 7 ÷ 8

⇒ MP = 700 × 8 ÷ 7 = ₹800

⇒ If no discount is given, the selling price equals the marked price.

⇒ New SP = ₹800

⇒ Profit% in this case = 60%

⇒ New SP = CP × (100 + 60) ÷ 100

⇒ 800 = CP × 160 ÷ 100

⇒ 800 = CP × 8 ÷ 5

⇒ CP = 800 × 5 ÷ 8 = ₹500

**∴ The correct answer is ₹500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price and Selling Price

Marked Price (MP) is the printed price of an article. Discount is always calculated on the MP. Formula: SP = MP − Discount.

Direct Relation between CP and MP

A highly useful formula linking Cost Price and Marked Price directly is: CP / MP = (100 − Discount%) / (100 + Profit%).

Successive Discounts

If two successive discounts of d₁% and d₂% are given, the equivalent single discount is (d₁ + d₂ − d₁×d₂ / 100)%.

questions.question: 2 men and 7 women can do a piece of work in 14 days whereas 3 men and 8 women can do it in 11 days. In how many days 5 men and 4 women can do the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

2m + 7w = 14 days

3m + 8w = 11 days

**Formula used:**

Total work = Efficiency × days 

**Calculations:**

⇒ (2m + 7w)14 = (3m + 8w)11

⇒ 28m + 98w = 33m + 88w

⇒ 10w = 5m

⇒ m/w = 2/1

⇒ Total work = (2 × 2 + 7 × 1) × 14

⇒ Total work = 11 × 14

Time taken by 5m and 4 w = (11 × 14)/(5 × 2 + 4 × 1)

⇒ 11 days

**∴ Time taken by 5 man and 4 woman is 11 days.**

questions.question: A park is in the shape of a rectangle. Its length and breadth are 240 m and 100 m, respectively. At the centre of the park. there is a circular lawn. The area of the park, excluding the lawn is 3904 m². What is the perimeter (in m) of the lawn? (use π = 3.14 )
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:-**

 Length and Breadth of the rectangular park = 240 m and 100 m, Area of the park, excluding the lawn = 3904 m²

**FORMULA USED:- **

Area of Rectangle = Length × Breadth 

Area of Circle = **π**R²

The perimeter of Circle = 2**π**R

Area of the rectangular park - Area of the circular lawn

**CALCULATION:-**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6e37568855becec3576d099df8b852a33199ff549c6860101e93bd7855b93d8.png] 

⇒ 240 × 100 - **π**R² = 3904 

⇒ 3.14 × R² = 24000 - 3904 = 20096

⇒ R² = 20096 ÷ 3.14 = 6400 

⇒ R = 80 m

The radius of the circular lawn = 80 m

⇒ Perimeter of circular lawn = 2**π**R

⇒ 2 × 3.14 × 80 = 502.4 m

**∴ The perimeter of the circular lawn = 502.4 m**

questions.question:
What is the mean of the range, median and mode of the data given below?

1, 2, 5, 9, 6, 3, 9, 7, 4, 3, 9, 1, 9, 6, 8, 1
questions.solution:
**Given: **

1, 2, 5, 9, 6, 3, 9, 7, 4, 3, 9, 1, 9, 6, 8, 1

**Concept: **

Mean = sum of all observations/number of observations 

Range = Highest value - lowest value

Median: First arrange the data in ascending or descending order 

when 'n' is odd then median is (n + 1)/2 th term of the data, when is even then median is the mean of the middle term of the data

Which number comes more times is the mode of the data

**Calculation: **

First data arrange in ascending order

1, 1, 1, 2, 3, 3, 4, 5, 6, 6, 7, 8, 9, 9, 9, 9

Range = 9 - 1

⇒ 8

Here, n = 16(even)

The middle term of the data is 5 and 6

Median = (5 + 6)/2

⇒ 5.5

The mode is 9, because 9 comes 4 times 

 So, the mean of range, median, and mode of the data is

Mean = (9 + 5.5 + 8)/3

⇒ 22.5/3

⇒ 7.5

**∴ 7.5**

questions.question: The average height of a certain number of persons in a group is 155.5 cm. Later on, 4 persons of height 154.6 cm, 158.4 cm, 152.2 cm and 153.8 cm leave the group. As a result the average height of the remaining persons increases by 0.15 cm. What was the number of persons initially in the group?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Average = 155.5 cm

4 persons of height 154.6 cm, 158.4 cm, 152.2 cm, and 153.8 cm leave the group, then the average of remaining persons is increased by 0.15 cm.

**Concept: **

Average = sum of all observations/number of observations

**Calculations: **

Let the total number of the person initially in the group is x

Now, the sum of the height of all person is

⇒ 155.5x cm

Sum of the height of 4 persons which leave the group

⇒ (154.6 + 158.4 + 152.2 + 153.8) cm

⇒ 619 cm

Now, the sum of the height of remaining persons of the group is

⇒ (155.5x - 619) cm

The remaining number of the person in the group is

⇒ (x - 4)

New average of the group is 

⇒ 155.5 + 0.15

⇒ 155.65 cm

Sum of observations = average × number of observations

⇒ 155.65(x - 4) = 155.5x - 619

⇒ 155.65x - 622.60 = 155.5x - 619

⇒ 155.65x - 155.5x = 622.60 - 619.00

⇒ 0.15x = 3.60

⇒ x = 3.60/0.15

⇒ x = 24

**Hence, the number of persons in the group initially is 24 **

 

**Short trick: **

Sum of the height of 4 persons which leave the group is

⇒ (154.6 + 158.4 + 152.2 + 153.8) cm

⇒ 619 cm

A/c to average(155.5 cm) sum height of 4 persons is

⇒ 4 × 155.5

⇒ 622 cm

The difference in both sum

⇒ 622 - 619

⇒ 3 cm

This extra 3 cm distributed among the remaining persons

⇒ 3/0.15

⇒ 20

So, the total number of persons in the group 

⇒ 20 + 4

⇒ 24

**∴ 24**

questions.question: Two numbers are in the ratio 3 ∶ 5. If 9 is subtracted from each, the numbers so obtained are in the ratio 12 ∶ 23. If 3 is added to the smaller number and 7 is subtracted from the other number, there they will be in the ratio:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of two numbers = 3 ∶ 5 

After subtracted 9 from each number so new ratio = 12 ∶ 23

**Calculations:**

Let the first and second number be 3x and 5x respectively

According to the question,

(3x – 9)/(5x – 9) = 12/23

⇒ (x – 3)/(5x – 9) = 4/23 

⇒ 23x – 69 = 20x – 36 

⇒ 3x = 33 

⇒ x = 11 

So, first number = 3x = 33 

Second number = 5x = 55 

3 is added to the smaller number and 7 is subtracted from the other number

Required ratio = (33 + 3) ∶ (55 – 7) = 36 ∶ 48 = 3 ∶ 4

**∴ Required ratio is 3 ∶ 4**
